Gambling Therapy – Platform for gambling related harms

Whether you’re concerned about your own gambling, worried about someone you care about, or looking for professional support, Gambling Therapy provides the information, tools, treatment and recovery resources you need.

As the world’s leading platform dedicated to gambling-related harm, we bring together everything you need in one place, helping people understand their relationship with gambling, access effective support, and build lasting recovery.

No matter where you are in your journey, we’re here to help you:

A Global Platform. Local Support.

Gambling harm affects millions of people worldwide. Our mission is to ensure that anyone, anywhere, can access trusted information, effective support and a pathway to recovery.

By bringing together education, treatment and recovery under one platform, we’re creating a world where help is easier to find and recovery is possible for everyone.
